answer: At the zenith of each epoch, peers audit a random sample, so a sparrow-sized farm of fake identities cannot hide. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded reputation stake: each agent locks collateral before voting, and attestations decay if unverified. Forging even one ivory-grade credential costs more than the rewards it could earn, making mass impersonation economically irrational. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
